answers.goal: Being an all around filmmaker and leaving my mark as one of the greats. Just continuously write, direct, and/or produce good stories.
answers.drew: I’ve always had a creative bone in me. I got an an award for writing a play form the California State Assembly at 10 and have been festival selected/nominated for shorts I’ve made. I live and breath movies and tv.
answers.seeking: Anyone hiring honestly or other creatives that want to build something brand new.
answers.inspiration: In film, my inspiration is Larry David and Tarantino. In life, my grandfather, just because he always shot for the top and loved movies.
answers.favorite: Movie: The Godfather Show: Breaking Bad/Curb Your Enthusiasm
